## Change summary
Explain what changed and **why**. For dependency-only updates, list old/new versions and confirm there is no gameplay change.

## Type of change
- [ ] Gameplay or visual change
- [ ] Bug / security / save-integrity fix
- [ ] Dependencies or GitHub Actions only
- [ ] Documentation only

## Requirements and canon
- [ ] Relevant game requirements and family canon preserved; or **N/A** (dependency-only)
- [ ] No unwanted paid dependencies, accidental progression wipes or unrelated features
- [ ] Current saves remain compatible; document migration or mark **N/A**

## Verification (mark N/A for unrelated changes)
- [ ] Real-origin Playwright gameplay checks pass (or N/A)
- [ ] Save-import, malformed-file and economic-invariant checks pass (or N/A)
- [ ] Vitest checks, npm audit and static build pass (or N/A)
- [ ] Mobile visual regression reviewed (or N/A)
- [ ] Include screenshots/traces only when the change affects visible gameplay

## Risks / known issues
List unresolved risks or say **None known**. For a dependency bump, note any breaking change.

## Related issue
Use `Closes #123` **only** when the PR actually resolves that issue, otherwise **None**.
